How many orders were placed in Q3 2025?.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2025-07-01' AND order_date < '2025-10-01'

What was total revenue by region for Q3.sql: SELECT r.name AS region, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)), 2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN regions r ON r.id = c.region_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= '2025-07-01' AND o.order_date < '2025-10-01' GROUP BY r.name ORDER BY revenue DESC

Show me average order value by customer.sql: SELECT c.segment, ROUND(AVG(o.total_amount), 2) AS avg_order_value FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC
